#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn example_one() {
        assert_eq!(run("product p1 widget 1000 5
product p2 gadget 250 20
customer c1 ann
customer c2 bob
order o1 c1 p1:2,p2:8
order o2 c2 p1:3,p9:1
order o3 c2 p1:4,p2:1
restock p1 10
return o1 3
report
top
".as_bytes()), ("OK o1 3800
ERR 6 unknown_product
BACKORDER o3
FILLED o3 4250
RETURNED o1 1140
--- customers
c1 1 2660 0 2660
c2 1 4250 0 4250
--- products
p1 11 4
p2 12 8
--- top
p2 8
p1 4
".to_string(), true));
    }

    #[test]
    fn example_two() {
        assert_eq!(run("product p1 a 100 10
product p2 b 10 10
customer c1 x silver
promo p2 40
tax 10

order o2 c1 p1 5

order o5 c1 p1:1,p1:1
report
".as_bytes()), ("OK o1 534
OK o2 533
ERR 8 invalid
ERR 9 invalid
BACKORDER o5
--- customers
c1 2 1067 96 1067
--- products
p1 0 10
p2 5 5
".to_string(), true));
    }
}
